paper_title: LaSQuE Improved Zero-Shot Classification from Explanations Through   Quantifier Modeling and Curriculum Learning
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of “Attention Length” values. The horizontal axis, labeled “Exp. Length,” ranges from 5 to 35 and is marked with numerical tick labels at intervals of 5 units. The vertical axis, labeled “Weights,” ranges from 0.20 to 0.45 and is marked with numerical tick labels at intervals of 0.05.  There are five bars, each colored blue, representing values at 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, and 30. The bar corresponding to “Exp. Length” of 5 has a height of approximately 0.35, the bar at 10 has a height of 0.40, the bar at 15 has a height of 0.40, the bar at 20 has a height of 0.35, the bar at 25 has a height of 0.30 and the bar at 30 has a height of 0.35. The bars are not sorted in any particular order.
